children: shares fell to their lowest level in nearly a year as investors looked past a
top- and bottom-line beat that was boosted by tariff refunds and interest income.
The retailer saw a 9.4% increase in sales and a 75% increase in per share profits, the latter of which, however, was influenced by nearly $200M in tariff refunds.

Additionally, a 980-basis point expansion to its gross margin was also inflated by tariff refunds, which drove 1,300 basis points of the gross margin expansion. Excluding this impact, American Eagle’s
gross profit margin was compressed in the second quarter.
“The underlying Q2 report was relatively weak,” says Morgan Stanley analyst Alex Straton, as stronger topline growth was offset by gross margin pressure from elevated American Eagle markdowns.
“Notably, this makes American Eagle one of the few stocks in our coverage not to beat Q2 consensus EBIT/EPS expectations,” Straton adds.

While a multi-million-dollar tariff refund distorted the company’s bottom-line, the results also “tell the tale of two brands,” says Needham’s Tom Nikic, with Aerie remaining "red-hot" but the larger American Eagle brand “still a bit of a mixed bag.”
This was reflected in comparable sales between the two brands. While Aerie comparable sales soared 19%, American Eagle was down 1% with women’s bottoms continuing to weigh.
Jennifer Foyle, American Eagle’s executive creative director of AE and Aerie
in women’s bottoms to softness in denim, as other categories, like cargo pants, have done “exceptionally well.”
Seasonal categories were also a drag and will likely continue into the third quarter as the company continues its work selling older, slower-moving styles.

“As such, American Eagle comps are expected to improve only modestly to flattish growth year-over-year in Q3, but with incremental promotions due to carryover of seasonal inventory from the first half of the year,” Nikic writes.

Nikic maintained his neutral rating on American Eagle, as did Straton, who says her Equal-weight view remains largely unchanged, as underlying Q2 results and mostly unchanged/modestly lower underlying full-year guidance do little to alter her view that “American Eagle’s long-term margin trajectory and earnings power are unlikely to materially improve from recent annual levels.”

title: American Eagle Q2 beat disguises 'relatively weak' report -- analysts
